name: Neural Language Model
description: End-to-end neural network models (e.g., Opus 4.6, Qwen3-8B) that map text to text. Traditionally the exclusive focus of scaling efforts, but the author argues they are severely underutilized without scaffolding.

edges.quote: the language models we interact with in the (near) future will be what we call scaffolds today
How do you begin to evaluate between scaffolds like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity with anything other than 'vibes'?
